pricing_power: Further digital delivery and handling cost inflation, deeper customer-value price investment, IRA pharmacy reimbursement pressure, wage and union cost inflation, and the $774m opioid settlement payable over nine years (2026-04-14, primary). web_bottleneck: The company's bottleneck is soft industry unit trends and a cautious consumer, plus an estimated 150 basis point IRA Medicare Drug Price Negotiation pharmacy headwind (2026-07-23, primary). Its own remedy needs faster execution and scale leverage from the ACI Edge reorganization and centralized center-store merchandising.
web_who_benefits_next: Value and club retailers and discount grocers gain share as ACI core traffic weakens (2026-07-23, primary). Second order: delivery and gig-delivery providers fed by ACI digital growth of 13%, and suppliers serving the newly centralized center-store merchandising team, plus any incoming CFO and Executive Chair turnaround mandates.
web_who_loses: If Albertsons price investment and ACI Edge work, traditional supermarket peers and their center-store suppliers lose share and pricing power. Pharmacy intermediaries lose as ACI leans on IRA-driven pharmacy margin, and shareholders lose if buybacks and dividends keep masking a falling earnings base.
